justification: Bug 4 Stage 1: sharpen the strata classifier with the StrataHub lot count so apartment-vs-townhouse is decided by the authoritative lot count rather than the weak lot-area heuristic. Shrinks the AMBIGUOUS band that drives both Bug 4 symptoms (silent blank for apartments + wrong house-yield default).

pre_impl.existing_data: The brief's strata path used detect_strata (NSW Cadastre) which returns is_strata/plan_type but NO lot count. The StrataHub lot count (query_strata_at_point -> lot_total, classify_dwelling_type boundaries) lived in services/strata_lookup.py and was not wired into the brief.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Plan assumed the lot count was already fetched in the brief path. It was not — Stage 1 had to wire StrataHub in, not just tweak classify_strata.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive: classify_strata gains a lot-count branch ahead of the unchanged area fallback; _fetch_strata enriches the cadastre dict with StrataHub lot_total best-effort. Both brief assembly paths (non-streaming + streaming) share these two functions, so both benefit with no call-site changes.

functions.name: classify_strata
functions.input: strata_info dict (may carry lot_total from StrataHub) + lot_area_m2
functions.if_none: no/invalid lot_total -> area heuristic (unchanged); no area -> AMBIGUOUS

functions.name: _fetch_strata
functions.output: cadastre strata dict, enriched with lot_total + dwelling_type when StrataHub returns a plan
functions.if_none: StrataHub failure or non-strata cadastre -> dict returned unchanged (best-effort, never fails the brief)

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded; lot-count boundaries (<=4 townhouse, 5+ apartment) mirror the smoke-tested strata_lookup.classify_dwelling_type
queries: N/A - no SQL DB queries in this change. The only data fetch is a read-only StrataHub ArcGIS point-intersect (public, no auth) via query_strata_at_point, gated to run only when the cadastre already indicates strata involvement.

break_it.scenario: Townhouse complex (3 lots) on a large 3000m2 parent lot
break_it.what_happens: Old area heuristic called it APARTMENT (>2500m2) -> RenovationBrief, no development analysis (the spike bug)
Could raise and fail the whole brief, or write a bad lot_total
break_it.repro: query_strata_at_point raises; or returns lot_total in {0, None, True, 1.5, '6'}
break_it.how: _fetch_strata wraps StrataHub in try/except (best-effort); classify_strata guards isinstance(int) and excludes bool, falling back to area; tests test_fetch_strata_swallows_strata_hub_failure + test_invalid_lot_count_falls_through_to_area

break_it.what_happens: Needless StrataHub call on every lookup
break_it.repro: _fetch_strata for a Torrens parcel (is_strata False, parent_has_strata False)
break_it.how: StrataHub call gated behind is_strata or parent_has_strata; test_fetch_strata_skips_strata_hub_when_not_strata asserts zero calls

post_merge.manual_verify: On a known apartment address (large strata plan) confirm the brief now classifies APARTMENT via lot count; on a townhouse-on-large-lot confirm DEVELOPMENT. Stage 2 (explain the blank) + Stage 3 (conditional potential) follow in separate PRs per ce-bug4-strata-capacity-salvage-2026-06.md.
